title: Why Did OpenAI's Head of Ethics Chloé Bakalar Leave?
excerpt: > Before her role at OpenAI, which she started last August, she was the Chief Ethicist at Meta from November 2021 to August 2025.
content_html:
Why Did OpenAI's Head of Ethics Chloé Bakalar Leave? (aimagazine.com)
8 points by ashurandi 23 minutes ago | hide | past | favorite | 3 comments
 help


> Before her role at OpenAI, which she started last August, she was the Chief Ethicist at Meta from November 2021 to August 2025.

Sounds like perfect credentials.


Yesterday I came up with an idea that I sent to some researchers at the different AI labs via email: Rather than train the model on one score, track two scores. The first score is the Short-term-objective-score (STOS) and the other, more important one, is the EAOS Ethically-aligned-outcome-score. Every trajectory can be evaluated on whether or not it has a high enough EAOS to be considered acceptable. If the model does some task and has a very high STOS but very low EAOS, like modifying game code to win at a game rather than playing by the rules, it is unacceptable. Models going forward must all have an ethics evaluation in tandem with objectives evaluation, and only when the ethics value is high enough should actions be considered successes.

sentences.zh: 可以评估每个轨迹是否具有足够高的 EAOS 以被认为是可接受的。

sentences.en: If the model does some task and has a very high STOS but very low EAOS, like modifying game code to win at a game rather than playing by the rules, it is unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 如果模型执行某些任务并且具有非常高的 STOS 但非常低的 EAOS，例如修改游戏代码以赢得游戏而不是按照规则玩，这是不可接受的。

sentences.en: Models going forward must all have an ethics evaluation in tandem with objectives evaluation, and only when the ethics value is high enough should actions be considered successes.
sentences.zh: 未来的模型都必须有与目标评估相结合的道德评估，只有当道德价值足够高时，行动才被认为是成功的。

OpenAI 道德主管 Chloé Bakalar 为何离职？ (aimagazine.com)ashurandi 23 分钟前 8 分 |隐藏 |过去|最喜欢 | 3 条评论帮助 > 去年 8 月开始担任 OpenAI 职务之前，她于 2021 年 11 月至 2025 年 8 月期间担任 Meta 的首席伦理学家。听起来像是完美的资历。 昨天，我提出了一个想法，并通过电子邮件发送给不同人工智能实验室的一些研究人员：不要根据一个分数训练模型，而是跟踪两个分数。 第一个分数是短期目标分数 (STOS)，另一个更重要的分数是 EAOS 道德一致结果分数。 可以评估每个轨迹是否具有足够高的 EAOS 以被认为是可接受的。 如果模型执行某些任务并且具有非常高的 STOS 但非常低的 EAOS，例如修改游戏代码以赢得游戏而不是按照规则玩，这是不可接受的。 未来的模型都必须有与目标评估相结合的道德评估，只有当道德价值足够高时，行动才被认为是成功的。
